The examination of the course consists of two parts: 

- a short essay (1-2 pages) following the seminar on Day 4
- a group project on multi omics data, with presentation the **30rd October**.


#### Details on the project course
The objective is for the students to perform omics data analysis using the methodologies presented in the course.

During the first day of the course, we will present three multi-omics datasets. 
And, for each dataset, we will propose two different objectives, for a total of six different projects.

Students will be divided into grups of 4-5.

The students will be able to express their preferred dataset.



and to present the results during an oral presentation (tentative date: 30rd October 2025).


schedule of presentations

Presentation: 30 minutes, 10 minutes discussion (with questions from the other group). 
Everybody should contribute.
Brief background, figures generated, methods (why were they chosen), conclusions, limitations. 

One session per dataset, mandatory to be present at least for that.
